notes.title: Style Update!
notes.notes:
Hello guys! Check out the latest update which includes:

 Prettier effects, New Explosions, New Fire Effect, New Bullet Effects, New Power Up Effects

New Passive Abilities that make punching your enemies much more satisfying!  Use the gold you earned slaying enemies at the game console in the living room at the main menu!

Increased the potency of the Gatling Gun power up by increasing the rate of fire and size of bullets. Pew Pew!  

Also some minor bug fixes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34965777/cbcfc8864ce44c82619a1f383081140b767443d5.jpg

Currently working on: 


 [spoiler]New Stage that will take place in a small town which will include Destructible Buildings and Stage Hazards to toss your foes into!
[/spoiler]

I intend to enhance the graphics as well so the game doesn't look so simple while still remaining a low poly environment! Let me know what you think!

notes.title: Unlockables Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! This is the first of many updates!  I'm currently working on an update including unlockables such as passives for use any time you play without having to buy them each run! 

 Feel like punching enemies with fire or lightning!?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34965777/b1f494414876be7a28230bc42dd863f07877a9b0.jpg

 I got you!

 This will also include some bug fixes as well as some cosmetic changes! This update will be available over the next few days or so!

I've got a lot planned and it's so exciting to see things moving along!
